title: Chapter 307: Scorpion Kills The Strong
content:
Chapter 307: Scorpion Kills The Strong

The seven-star strongmen of the desert races moved very quickly, and the Zerg had six-star Zerg hosts specifically watching them.

As soon as they moved, the six-star Zerg queens specially used to deal with them flew to the high altitude of the front line to try to increase the range of the spawning attack.

The five-star transport Zerg host carrying the six-star Zerg scorpion flew stealthily into the sky above the desert race army, allowing the six-star Zerg scorpion staying on the platform transformed by the transport Zerg host with its tentacles to bring the seven-star strongmen of the desert races into the attack range in advance.

Some of the seven-star strongmen of the desert races, including some magic strongmen, faintly sent energy fluctuations, and they were ready to take action at any time.

"Scorpion, try first to see if you can kill him. If not, the Queen will take action!"

"If something unusual happens, Queen, you take action yourself!"

"When you take action, use all your strength and beat him upside down!"

Wu Qing's consciousness shifted to the battlefield, and he ordered the Queen.

Now it is the seven-star powerhouse of the desert race. He has the intention to participate in the war, but after all, he has not taken action. This is like the seven-star powerhouse in the alien human army, who only transported the parts of the space transmission channel and did not participate in the war.

If the Zerg attacks the seven-star powerhouse of the desert race first, it will be considered that the Zerg has broken the rules.

But for Wu Qing and the Zerg, this rule is meaningless. The rules are only used to restrain the weak.

The six-star Zerg scorpion, which received the attack order, launched an extermination attack on a powerhouse that is one star higher than them for the first time.

This is also the first time that the Zerg has taken action against the powerhouse of this world. Wu Qing is also very curious about what kind of combat power the powerhouse that all races in this world fear has.

The magical spores released by the six-star Zerg scorpion in the air, like the Zerg Queen's spawning attack, transcended the limitations of space, ignored any defensive interference, and directly hit the seven-star strongmen of the desert races moving at high speed.

The Zerg has one hundred six-star Zerg scorpions, and their attacks have hit all the seven-star strongmen of the desert races.

The Zerg scorpion's domineering elimination ability and powerful rule-level power directly judge that the target that meets the elimination conditions will disappear without a trace!

Everything about the target has turned into nothingness and disappeared!

This is the power of the rule-level power!

There is no reason!

Nearly a hundred seven-star strongmen of the desert races suddenly disappeared during the march, which shocked the stronger desert races and the Naga tribe who were closely following their actions!

"What's going on? Did the powerful Zerg take action personally?"

"It's unlikely that the powerful will take action! It should be a powerful army!"

"It has the ability to make the strong disappear directly! This rule power is too strong!"

"No wonder they don't let us take action, it turns out that they are fully prepared!"

"In this situation, it depends on how the evil god camp chooses!"

"Whether to continue to invest or wisely withdraw, it requires strong pressure!"

"Yes, facing a race like the Zerg, even if my race uses all its strength, there is no chance of winning!"

"It is impossible for the desert race to retreat. No matter what the desert race chooses, it seems that there is no suspense for my race to win this great victory for free!"

"Haha, this Zerg is honest! It's worth making friends with!"

"The Zerg is a race that has just entered the world, and it is relatively pure in its dealings. I hope they can always maintain this purity!"

"..."

The Naga strongman, who was a little nervous, saw the ability of the Zerg and was completely relieved.

Although they were not afraid to join the battle, they were inevitably injured and often killed when fighting with enemies of the same level.

The Zerg fought the Desert Race alone, and they were not allowed to fight, which was their lifesaver.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

One hundred thousand five-star Zerg Sky Guards attacked non-stop, and their huge bodies hovered in the sky, occupying a very wide area of airspace.

Beside them were the equally huge five-star Zerg Devourers and the relatively petite Zerg Dragons.

The continuous attacks of one hundred thousand five-star Zerg Sky Guards had broken up the five-star troops in the core army of the Desert Race, and they lost their organization and mixed into other troops.

But they were locked by the Zerg Host in the sky, and they could not hide no matter how they tried. The attacks of the Zerg Sky Guards could still accurately attack the area where they were.

The few six-star soldiers in the core army of the desert race were hit by the ultra-precise single-point attack mode of the five-star Zerg Sky Guard. With one strike, one or several six-star soldiers of the desert race were severely injured or even killed.

The ultimate Zerg soldier, the Zerg Sky Guard, is a super-enhanced version of the Zerg Destroyer. The super tribe of the alien race could not do anything to the much weaker Zerg Destroyer.

Now the desert race has no way to deal with the stronger Zerg Sky Guard and can only passively take the beating.

The seven-star strongmen were sent out, but they also lost their lives in vain. The desert race is still confused about who launched the attack.

"Lord God's Envoy, do you want to send strong men to fight?"

The powerful desert lizard man respectfully asked a mysterious man in a yellow robe in front of him.

"No need, go and arrange the retreat, and withdraw from this desert territory first!"

"There are powerful people hiding on the opposite side. I have no chance of winning even if I take action myself. Let's give up here first!"

The yellow-robed envoy said in a gentle tone.

"Yes, Lord Envoy, I will arrange it now!"

The powerful desert lizardman took the order and left.

...

The desert race dispatched a group of seven-star strongmen, and no strongmen came forward afterwards.

Wu Qing discovered through the Zerg host that the strong men of the desert race who were hiding in the dark were also leaving one after another.

"There is a real strong man in the desert race, and the means you prepared should have been discovered by him!"

Wu Qing said to the Queen of the Insects.

"I wanted you to go all out once, so that the Zerg hive can level up twice, but now it seems that it won't work!"

"These desert races are going to retreat. We have to end the war here as soon as possible and try to annihilate more enemies!"

After talking to the Queen of the Zerg, Wu Qing also turned into a spectator, watching the performance of the Zerg army through the Zerg host in the sky.

The desert race decided to retreat, which is a big strategy, but the army assembled this time has no way to retreat again.

The desert army here is to buy time for the desert race to retreat and consume as much Zerg troops as possible to reduce losses.

So, in this war, the contest between the strong ended in an instant, and the war between the armies has just begun.

This war between the warring parties on a billion-level scale is also the first time Wu Qing has seen it in this world.

Everywhere Wu Qing saw, there were densely packed soldiers from both armies. Here, life has become the least valuable thing.

Every second, countless lives disappear.

If Wu Qing were to command a war of this scale, even if he was commanding the most elite human subordinates, he could only command the grand strategy. The specific operations and coordination in various places on the battlefield had to be commanded by commanders at all levels.

Only the queen of the Zerg could command hundreds of millions of people to fight as if she was commanding one person, and there was no big difference at all.

The Zerg army has a command system and powerful combat power that defies heaven. What they are pursuing now is no longer victory, but how to get the biggest gain at the lowest cost.

The core army of the desert race finally entered the attack range of the five-star Zerg Devourer of the Zerg under the continuous attack of the five-star Zerg Sky Guard.

Together with the Naga army, the more than 500,000 Zerg Destroyers in the relatively backward formation can also reach the desert army.

The five-star Zerg Devourers and Zerg Destroyers began to attack the core army of the desert race.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Accompanied by the familiar sound of the Zerg Destroyer's artillery fire, the core army of the desert race began to counterattack.

A large number of desert race magic troops began to cast spells together. The clear sky began to blow sand again. Auxiliary large-scale battlefield magic was being cast quickly.

The attack of 100,000 five-star Zerg air guards immediately turned to those powerful desert race magic troops.

Such large-scale battlefield auxiliary magic had little effect on the Zerg army. The five-star transport Zerg host transported 100 six-star Zerg scorpions and 100 six-star Zerg mammoths, which were transported and sent to the long front line one by one.

Although the number of six-star troops was small, their cooperation in pairs was enough to affect a long front line. If one hundred pairs were arranged, the front line of thousands of kilometers was within their influence range.

The six-star Zerg scorpions continuously released plagues, creating a huge plague infection area. The six-star Zerg mammoths treated the enemy as nothing, colliding back and forth on the long front line, cutting the enemy's formation, and paving the way for the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to attack.

Zerg scorpions, Zerg mammoths, Zerg puppies and type three Zerg poisonous ray scorpions worked together on the ground, quickly wiped out the ordinary army of the desert race, and fought against the elite troops of the core army of the desert race that had already rushed up.

The so-called elite troops in the core army of the desert race did not improve much when they encountered the plague of six-star Zerg scorpions, and they were also slaughtered in large numbers.

One hundred thousand five-star Zerg devourers and five million Zerg flying dragons, in conjunction with the ubiquitous type three poisonous ray scorpions on the ground, fought a fierce battle with the air forces such as the Desert Eagle and the Desert Vulture in the core army of the desert race that rushed straight up.

Wu Qing greatly increased the number of the type three Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, which only consumes 5 gas. When the air forces of the desert race flew over, the poisonous rays shot from the ground battlefield were dense and dense, weaving a green light net in the sky.

Together with the terrifying slime attacks of the 100,000 five-star Zerg Devourers scattered across the entire front, and the Zerg Dragons that served as the last line of air defense, they formed an air defense network that the desert race's air forces could not break through.
